en: Colorized vintage postcard showing a large, elegant late‑19th‑century mansion used as a university building. It has a mansard roof with dormer windows, ornate stone façade and tall windows. A few pedestrians and a dog walk along the broad street in front. Trees and a garden surround the building, with another structure and a church or tower visible in the background. Printed caption text appears at the top left.
